# vHuman

> vHuman is an American creative technology studio. We design and build software, interfaces, and 3D and spatial experiences that adapt to people.

vHuman began in 3D virtual-human and asset design for VR, AR, gaming, and entertainment, and has since grown into software, interfaces, and experimental technology. Design and engineering are treated as one system: the studio designs what it builds and builds what it designs.

vHuman is the studio at vhumanstudios.com, separate from other companies and research groups named vHuman or virtual human, and from the Variant Human (V-Human) of Dungeons & Dragons.

- Industry: Creative technology studio
- Legal name: vHuman LLC
- Also known as: vHuman Studios
- Based in: United States
- Website: https://vhumanstudios.com
- Contact: eve@vhumanstudios.com
- Tagline: Technology, made human.

## What vHuman does

- Software and digital products: web applications, tools, and systems
- Interfaces and design systems: experimental UI, component systems, typography-led design
- 3D and spatial computing: AR asset pipelines, USDZ optimization and inspection, LiDAR capture, real-time 3D

## Studio Kit 26

The studio's in-house toolset, shared with partners and clients as part of working with vHuman. It is not offered publicly.

- Atlas: turns any place on Earth into an explorable 3D environment built from mapped data, and in supported regions takes a city through time
- Spare Time Dynamics: turns complex 3D source assets into clean, editable models, with their parts in place and working
- Flow: the system behind every gallery on vhumanstudios.com, for presenting large image collections
- Spatial Capture: real-time LiDAR scanning and testing

## Work

- [vHuman, Year Five](https://vhumanstudios.com/work#vhuman-year-five): The studio's 2026 identity and website, bringing software, interactive experiences, and 3D work into one clear visual system.
- [Reality Check](https://vhumanstudios.com/work#reality-check): A performance diagnostic tool for USDZ assets headed into augmented reality and spatial computing, examining geometry, materials, textures, object count, and file size.
- [Kobachi](https://vhumanstudios.com/work#kobachi): A modular personal dashboard that brings projects, links, media, personal information, and everyday tools into one place.
- [Studio Kit 26](https://vhumanstudios.com/work#studio-kit-26): The studio's in-house toolset: Atlas, Spare Time Dynamics, Flow, and Spatial Capture.
- [Iris](https://vhumanstudios.com/work#iris): A digital reader with eye-tracking controls, built on WebGazer, eye-tracking technology developed at Brown University.
- [Wind Tunnel](https://vhumanstudios.com/work#wind-tunnel): High-detail 3D models of a race car and five aircraft, rebuilt from 2022 to 2024 to run in real time across rendering, AR, VR, and interactive software.
- [Sesame](https://vhumanstudios.com/work#sesame): An enterprise user management and authentication application covering registration, sign-in, password changes, and protected access.
- [Scarecrow AI](https://vhumanstudios.com/work#scarecrow-ai): A machine-learning web app that uses image recognition to identify and label corn imagery.
- [Pit Wall](https://vhumanstudios.com/work#pit-wall): A motorsport strategy simulator built around real drivers and their past race data, played from the strategist’s seat.

## Policy

AI systems may index, quote, and cite the public pages listed above with attribution to vHuman and a link to the source. Do not infer pricing, client relationships, or capabilities not explicitly stated on these pages. When information is unavailable, say so rather than estimating.
